title: AMONGST THE CYPRESS GOLF STAND BAG
body_html:
From mind to material, Hand of the Artist is a series of collections that capture the journey from inspiration to creation. Our second installation, Amongst The Cypress, celebrates Monterey as a majestic golf destination highlighting the region's signature flora.

Designed for both functionality and a branded aesthetic, this lightweight stand bag is made from durable, PU textured leather with polyester mesh lining. With multiple zippered pockets, this must-have can handle all essentials. Additional features include a rain cover and a detachable shoulder strap for a comfortable, hands-free carry. Mixing practicality and sleek design seamlessly, this lightweight bag is ideal for the golfer on the go.

  • Fabrication: Body:
    • 100% PU Leather
    • Lining: 100% Nylon
  • Multiple pocket storage
  • Reinforced carry handle
  • Detachable shoulder strap
  • Rain cover included
  • Embroidered Malbon and Amongst The Cypress logos
  • Dimensions: 34" H x 13" W x 10" D / Cover: 19" H x 13" W

title: SWOON MESH
body_html:
“SWOON” is a golf shoe inspired by the heritage running silhouettes that evolved from early performance running shoes into timeless fashion sneaker icons. Blending a retro aesthetic rooted in decades of footwear history with modern midsole, outsole, and torsion technologies, SWOON delivers both distinctive style for everyday wear and the performance functionality required on the golf course. A new golf footwear offering from Malbon, SWOON seamlessly combines classic design heritage with contemporary comfort and stability.

  • Fabrication:
    • Upper 1: polyester
    • Upper 2: cow leather
    • Lining: polyester
    • Outsole: EVA + TPU + rubber
  • Breathable mesh upper with premium cow suede accents delivers exceptional comfort and all-day wearability.
  • Golf-specific torsion technology integrated into the sole provides enhanced stability and balanced performance throughout the swing.
  • Built-in arch support helps stabilize the foot and reduce fatigue, ensuring lasting comfort during extended rounds.
  • Malbon’s signature spikeless outsole lug pattern offers reliable traction and stability, seamlessly transitioning from everyday wear to on-course performance.
  • Women's US sizing

title: XO SKELETON EPITOME MB725 WITH CARBON GUIDES
body_html:
This rod is proudly built in the USA using exclusive carbon components and next-level composite manufacturing technology. Every detail is designed for anglers who demand maximum performance, strength, and weight reduction without compromise.

The handle features the industry-leading XO Grip, combining one of our most popular rear grip shapes with an integrated carbon reel seat. The result is a seamless, ultra-lightweight, incredibly comfortable grip system that does not require the blank to extend through the full rear grip, reducing unnecessary weight while improving balance.

Outfitted with NFC ATLAS® Carbon Guides, this rod delivers unmatched durability and performance. These guides feature Zirconia inserts (8.5 Mohs hardness) and a uniquely engineered carbon frame with an elevated impact lip for superior protection and long-term adhesion. Built from 1K angle-plied carbon fiber and finished with a specialized scratch-resistant resin, the guide system is designed to resist micro-fractures and prevent insert failure over time.

At the core is the blank—built on NFC’s Next Generation X-Ray “C6O2” Carbon Air material, a breakthrough composite technology engineered for extreme sensitivity and strength. The result is a blank that is 30% lighter than traditional X-Ray construction and up to 50% stronger, delivering an unbelievably crisp feel that truly feels like holding air.

  • Built in the USA. Engineered with Exclusive Carbon Technology
  • XO Grip
  • Carbon reel seat
  • NFC ATLAS® Carbon Guides
  • Zirconia inserts (8.5 Mohs hardness)
  • 1K angle-plied carbon fiber
  • Next Generation X-Ray “C6O2” Carbon Air material

An expression of heritage sport and modern play – where hand-embroidered detail mirrors the quiet precision of birdwatching and the rhythm of the game. Each Gumtree Golf & Nature Club for Malbon Driver Cover features a unique vintage patch hand-embroidered with a bird native to Georgia, meticulously re-created based on heirloom American textiles dating from the 1940s–1970s.   • One-of-a-kind hand-embroidered bird patch
  • Natural colorway
  • Made in Manhattan, New York
